intro: One cup of sweetened kopi O has about 60 kcal (estimate). Almost all the calories come from sugar. Black coffee itself has almost no calories.

breakdown.part: Traditional coffee powder (roasted with sugar & margarine)

diet: Yes, kopi O is one of the lowest-calorie drinks at the kedai. One cup a day fits easily into your calorie budget. To save more, cut the sugar slowly. Just watch what you eat with it, like roti bakar kaya and half-boiled eggs.
tips: Order 'kopi O kurang manis' and save about half the calories.
Drink it hot in a small cup, which is smaller than an iced glass.
Pair it with half-boiled eggs for protein, and have less roti bakar kaya.

swap.name: Kopi O kurang manis
swap.why: Still strong kaw coffee taste, with half the sugar.

faq.q: Can I drink kopi O on an empty stomach?
faq.a: Many people are okay, but some get stomach discomfort. It's more comfortable with breakfast.

faq.q: Kopi O kosong is too bitter, how do I get used to it?
faq.a: Reduce sugar in stages, from normal to kurang manis, then very little. Your taste buds will adjust.

faq.q: How many cups of coffee a day is okay?
faq.a: Most healthy adults are fine with 2-3 cups. If you have trouble sleeping or feel your heart racing, cut down.
